_comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a recording of any site.
Reproduces the shape GET /manga?title=… returns: the paginated collection
envelope (result/response/data/limit/offset/total), each entry an entity
with a UUID, a language-keyed title map, an altTitles list of single-entry
maps, and relationships that carry attributes only because the request
asked for them with includes[]=cover_art.
Why synthetic: PLAN §1.3 forbids this repository from containing anything
that functions as a catalogue of sources, and §1.4 forbids copying others'
expression — including their data. The response *shape* is a documented
fact (https://api.mangadex.org/docs/, confirmed live 2026-09-15); the
titles, UUIDs and filenames here are invented, and the host the tests use
is example.invalid (RFC 2606), which can never resolve.
Deliberate variations exercised by the test:
- the first entry has no English title at all, only ja-ro, so the title
has to come from altTitles — MangaDex has no single canonical title
- the second is the ordinary case, English title present
- the third has a cover_art relationship with no attributes, which is
what a relationship looks like when includes[] was not sent
- the fourth has no usable title in any language and must be dropped
rather than rendered as an empty row
